preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of elements in each multiset n must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a) and all(1 <= b_i <= 10**9 for b_i in b)
preconditions.description: All elements in multisets a and b must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
The lengths of multisets a and b must be equal to n.
The total number of elements across all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be 'YES' if it is possible to transform multiset b into multiset a, otherwise 'NO'.
